column3: stressor
Kotlin value classes become the usual form for JVM library APIs. Clojure users ask to implement and consume them from defvaluetype.
A large company offers to buy value-type and close the source.
Nobody downloads value-type for two years.
A popular data library adopts value-type. Users increase from 10 to 100000 in one month.
Value classes become standard on every JVM. Nobody needs identity fallback.
Clojure contrib publishes a supported alternative to value-type with a different syntax.
closed-record becomes ten times more popular than value-type. Its users report all defects against value-type.
An IDE vendor sells a plugin that reads value-type private namespaces.
A user defines 50000 value types in one namespace.
A user evaluates defvaluetype inside a binding that changes *compile-files*.
A user sends serialized value objects over RMI to a JVM with no value classes.
Users put value objects as keys in a WeakHashMap.
A user redefines one value type 1000 times at the REPL, with different fields each time.
Users call array-info on arrays that another library made in a different class loader.
An operator sets policy error in production. A dependency contains fallback AOT output.
A user extends a protocol to a value type from a namespace that loads before the type.
A university course uses value-type on Java 21 without preview.
The maintainer gives value-type to clj-commons. Each review takes months.
AI agents open 500 pull requests in one week.
A contributor rewrites the value backend in Java.
The maintainer forgets the design reasons. The Ramora documents are out of date.
The Valhalla team hires the maintainer and forbids public work.
A reviewer with commit access merges a change that disables the error policy.
The maintainer's new employer forbids AI-written code.
The closed-record maintainer leaves. closed-record is not maintained.
A law requires a five-year security-update promise from maintainers who receive money.
A law requires an SBOM for each artifact on Clojars.
A court in one country decides that EPL 2.0 is not valid there.
Export control classifies JVM preview features as dual-use technology.
A court decides that AI-written code has no copyright. The licence of most of the code is not clear.
A regulator forbids preview JVM features and internal JDK packages in safety-critical software.
Oracle registers 'value class' as a trademark and forbids it in third-party documentation.
An audit requires a log entry for each run-time capability decision.
Clojars charges for each download.
The maintainer's machine fails. There is no money for a machine with enough memory for the matrix.
A sponsor pays only for work on arrays.
Memory prices fall 100 times. Memory savings from value classes are worth almost nothing.
GitHub charges for Actions caches and release storage.
A bounty pays for support of Clojure 1.10 and 1.11.
The AI agent service becomes free, but gives one answer each hour.
A company pays to keep EA3 supported for five years.
Oracle stops EA builds for macOS.
deps-deploy is abandoned and stops working with Clojars.
A clj-kondo release stops reading the defvaluetype lint hooks.
Clojure 1.13 replaces NewInstanceExpr with a new deftype compiler.
Clojure removes the class cache of DynamicClassLoader.
Vale changes its rules. All documents fail the prose check.
Adoptium publishes Valhalla builds with flags that are different from the Oracle builds.
quickdoc is abandoned.
GitHub is not available for one month.
The JVM adds a run-time flag that switches value classes off (-XX:-ValueClasses).
A new EA build removes ValueClass.newNullRestrictedAtomicArray.
The JVM changes == for value objects with float fields to compare bits.
Clojure compiles protocol calls to invokedynamic.
A new EA build limits value classes to 64 fields.
An application runs on the module path. value-type has no module-info.
Project Leyden AOT caches store loaded classes and replay them at startup.
A new EA build changes the class-file major version inside one feature release.
A GC in a new EA build moves flattened fields. Unsafe offsets become wrong.
Babashka supports defvaluetype through SCI.
A field tag names a class that is renamed between AOT compilation and run time.
A user stores value objects in Datomic and reads them after a change of representation.
An application uses the printed form of value objects as a cache key. The form changes with the representation.
The documented download SHA of the EA build is wrong and matches a different build.
An editor hot-swaps classes. The capability report shows the result from before the swap.
Deserialization with readObject puts nil into a :non-nil field.
Somebody rewrites the Git history. The commit count, and so the version, goes down.
A fixture file of the deftype compatibility corpus is corrupted.
An attacker uses an AI agent to submit a pull request that adds a hidden step to the transform.
An attacker replaces closed-record on Clojars with a version that pins an old value-type.
A new JDK access policy forbids defineClass for classes that are not hidden classes.
Attackers make many value objects with the same hash to slow down maps.
A dependency-confusion attack puts a false value-type.impl namespace earlier on the class path.
The GitHub Actions runner image is compromised.
Secrets in value-object fields appear in heap dumps of flat arrays, without their objects.
The EA JDK download site serves a trojan build.
A flood destroys the maintainer's machines and the backups in the same house.
A pandemic stops the maintainer's work for six months.
An internet outage cuts off the maintainer for two weeks during a JVM change.
A solar storm corrupts a Clojure JAR in the CI cache.
Embedded users run value-type on devices with 64 MB of memory.
Data centres in one region stop. The nearest Clojars mirror is not available.
The maintainer moves to a time zone 12 hours from all other contributors.
A war blocks the maintainer's access to GitHub and to Oracle sites.
Open-source developers strike against AI training on their code.
The Clojure community splits into two forks of Clojure.
A public campaign calls preview features unsafe. Libraries remove value-type.
A government requires all software to run on a national JVM fork without Valhalla.
Social media spreads a false claim that value-type corrupts data.
A country blocks Clojars.
Valhalla needs twenty more years to become final.
JEP 401 becomes final next month, two years early.
An application sets the fallback property with System/setProperty after value-type has loaded.
A server runs for five years with no restart. The JVM files are updated below it.
The release workflow runs on two commits at the same time.
A clock change makes build timestamps go backwards.
Clojure releases a new minor version each month.
An AOT-compiled application stays in production ten years after its JDK release ends.
Every value object becomes == to nil.
The JVM stores all value objects of one class in one memory location.
The Clojure reader reads defvaluetype as defrecord.
All class names become 1 MB long.
Each JVM start uses a random class-file major version.
The JVM refuses to load each class whose name contains 'Probe'.
java.util.UUID/randomUUID returns the same value on every call.
All arrays have length 0.
Every user believes that identity fallback classes are value classes.
Constructors run after the methods of the object.
GitHub deletes every repository with 'value' in its name.
The maintainer becomes 1000 people at the same time.
System/getProperty returns a different value each time it is read.
All Clojure symbols become case-insensitive.
java.lang.classfile moves to a separate module that the JVM does not resolve by default.
Clojure updates its bundled clojure.asm and removes the ClassWriter constructor that value-type uses.
A CVE in java.lang.classfile makes operators disable it with a JVM flag.
A build tool caches macroexpanded value definitions and evaluates them on a different JDK.
An nREPL middleware sends macroexpanded forms from the editor to a remote JVM.
A new EA build removes the NullRestricted annotation. Native non-nil fields are not possible.
A fire destroys the build machine during a release. It had the only copy of the benchmark results.
A popular blogger publishes benchmarks that show value-type slower than defrecord.
Monitoring calls value-type.capability/report on each request and alerts on each change.
clojure.asm and java.lang.classfile write the same bytes for every class.
A licence dispute removes clojure.asm from Clojure distributions in one country.
A cosmic ray changes one byte of the field-capability probe class in memory.
